style: Vertical 9:16 key art for a mobile horror game, painterly semi-realistic 3D-render look, cinematic lighting. Setting: an old abandoned Thai wooden sala (open pavilion with a pointed tiled roof and worn wooden posts) deep in a dark jungle at night, cold blue moonlight and mist outside, warm candlelight inside. The camera looks from the front edge of the sala floor toward the back, slightly from above, so the wooden floor fills the lower two thirds of the frame. On the floor stand rows of small white candles in clay holders, about 24 candles in 4 loose rows, each candle clearly separated with space around it. The top 18% of the image is dark roof beams and night sky with no important details. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no logo, no blood, no gore, no religious statues, no monks.

shots.prompt: Most candles are lit with bright warm flames, the sala floor glows warm orange and feels safe. Two candles are unlit with a thin wisp of grey smoke rising. One taller GOLDEN candle near the front glows with a soft golden halo, clearly special. Far away behind the sala, in the misty treeline, a pale female ghost stands barely visible: very long black hair hanging over her face, tattered old white dress, thin pale arms. She is small in the frame and half hidden in fog, creepy but distant.

Almost all candles have gone out, thin grey smoke trails rise from them, only four small flames remain and the sala is dark and cold blue. The pale female ghost now stands INSIDE the sala in the middle of the floor, close to the camera and large in the frame: very long wet black hair covering most of her face, one pale glowing eye visible through a gap in the hair, tattered old white dress, long thin pale fingers reaching toward a lit candle. Terrifying, eerie, tense, but no blood. One taller GOLDEN candle near the front still burns with a golden halo and the ghost leans away from it.
